name: Alberto Ascari
features: pale skin, dark hair thinning at the temples, heavy brows, broad calm face, stocky powerful build, light blue linen helmet, steady unhurried expression
bio: World Champion in 1952 and 1953, and so dominant in the Ferrari 500 that he won nine consecutive championship Grands Prix — a record that stood for over sixty years. Son of Antonio Ascari, who died racing when Alberto was seven. Superstitious, methodical, and almost unbeatable from the front. Survived a plunge into Monaco harbour in May 1955 and was killed four days later testing a sports Ferrari at Monza, bareheaded, in a borrowed helmet.
